tools.name: get_trending
tools.description:
Get a HotRepo trending board: the repositories on GitHub Trending (or HotRepo's new-repository board) for one
    UTC day, ranked by stars gained (new boards use measured Stars/hour), each with HotRepo's one-line review. From 2026-11-01
    boards list only repositories with a published review; earl

tools.name: get_repo
tools.description:
Read HotRepo's full review of a repository (Markdown), with its stats, topic, daily trending history (the all-languages board; each day's
    best_github_rank_that_day is the best position it reached on GitHub's page that day, null before 2026-10-24) and
    Hacker News threads that link to it. Only

tools.name: search_repos
tools.description: Search repositories that HotRepo has reviewed, newest reviews first. Use get_repo for the full review.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description:
List HotRepo's topics (each reviewed project belongs to exactly one, by what it helps people do) with the
    number of reviewed projects in each.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: List reviewed repositories in one topic, most recently trending first.

tools.name: get_monthly_report
tools.description:
Get a HotRepo monthly report: the repositories that gained the most stars on the daily trending board during
    a month, the most notable new repositories, and leaders per topic, with an editorial introduction.

tools.name: list_favorites
tools.description:
List the repositories the API key's owner has favorited on hotrepo.ai, most recently favorited first, with
    HotRepo's one-line review when one is published. Use get_repo for the full review. Favorites are added on the
    website's project pages, not through this server.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_trending" is 1379 chars, far longer than this server's median (211). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "get_repo" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
